scope: 2+1-dimensional level-three BF defect coupled to an induced metric and two fixed conserved stress probes
operatorBasisAssumption: Local diffeomorphism-invariant defect scalars use the induced metric and BF fields with no additional preferred tangential vector. Adding such a vector is additional medium/probe structure and does not evade flat-field-strength blindness.

dimensionConvention.note: The topological normalization makes c wedge da dimension three. Maxwell coefficients then have mass dimension minus one. Dimensions are defect EFT dimensions, not four-dimensional bulk dimensions.

discreteSector.flatHolonomy: exp(i integral a)=exp(2 pi i h/3), h=0,1,2
discreteSector.conventionalDiscreteSymmetryAssignment: a is a polar one-form and c is an axial one-form so the mutual BF term is P/T even
discreteSector.qualification: Individual CP labels depend on microscopic charge assignments; the ledger uses this conventional BF assignment.

operators.cpOrParity: even under the conventional polar-a/axial-c BF assignment
operators.localStress: zero in the closed defect bulk
operators.flatHolonomySensitivity: topological globally, absent from local Hilbert stress
operators.verdict: topological carrier, not the A11 stress bridge

operators.operator: epsilon^{ijk} a_i partial_j a_k or epsilon^{ijk} c_i partial_j c_k
operators.gaugeConsistent: only at quantized level with global/spin qualifications
operators.cpOrParity: odd for an ordinary one-form self Chern-Simons term
operators.localStress: zero in the closed defect bulk
operators.flatHolonomySensitivity: changes topological twist but supplies no local stress response
operators.coefficientStatus: quantized but not derived; the programme requires the untwisted class
operators.verdict: cannot realize A11 and may destroy the two-qutrit carrier

operators.cpOrParity: diagonal terms even; mixed a-c term odd under the conventional polar/axial assignment
operators.localStress: nonzero for flux or propagating field-strength excitations
operators.thirdDirectionCapacity: conditional on a defect tensor Gram matrix outside span(G2,G0), but not Z3-correlated for flat sectors
operators.verdict: smallest pure-gauge stress term; exact flat-holonomy no-go

operators.cpOrParity: even for a scalar with CP-even mass and kinetic terms
operators.flatHolonomySensitivity: none to the residual Z3 because charge q=3 has exp(2 pi i q h/3)=1
operators.thirdDirectionCapacity: may add a defect response direction but cannot correlate it with the residual Z3 holonomy
operators.coefficientStatus: present schematically in S_v1; defect spectrum and coefficients not derived
operators.verdict: the flavon that creates Z3 cannot itself read its flat residual holonomy

operators.operator: |D_a phi|^2+m_phi^2|phi|^2 for residual charge q not divisible by three
operators.cpOrParity: even for a parity-paired or complex scalar matter sector
operators.localStress: nonzero and conserved with the complete defect equations
operators.flatHolonomySensitivity: yes through the global covariant spectrum on a noncontractible cycle; no strictly local curvature expansion can see it
operators.thirdDirectionCapacity: conditional: requires defect localization/probe geometry to give G_phi outside span(G2,G0)
operators.coefficientStatus: field content, mass, charge, multiplicity and portal coefficients are not predicted
operators.verdict: smallest viable local microscopic completion, with globally nonlocal holonomy dependence after the matter is integrated out

operators.operator: bar psi (i gamma^i D_i[a]-m_psi) psi in a parity-paired charge sector
operators.gaugeConsistent: yes after the localized parity anomaly and regulator levels cancel
operators.cpOrParity: a single two-component mass is parity odd; a parity-paired completion can be even
operators.flatHolonomySensitivity: yes through the global charged spectrum
operators.thirdDirectionCapacity: conditional on transverse defect probe Gram and anomaly-safe pairing
operators.verdict: viable only after the existing localized Chern-Simons/parity-anomaly gate is passed

operators.operator: R_Sigma f_I,ij f_J^{ij}/Lambda^3 and higher derivative descendants
operators.cpOrParity: inherits the parity of f_I f_J
operators.localStress: nonzero away from a flat metric or with nonzero field strength
operators.flatHolonomySensitivity: none for flat gauge fields at fixed local geometry
operators.thirdDirectionCapacity: conditional but higher order and not flat-holonomy correlated
operators.verdict: not minimal and does not evade the local-flat no-go

operators.operator: W_q(C)=exp(i q integral_C a) inserted in or coupled to a detector functional
operators.cpOrParity: CP maps h to -h and W_q to its conjugate
operators.metricDependent: only through the contour/detector or charged matter that realizes it
operators.localStress: not a standalone local stress tensor
operators.thirdDirectionCapacity: conditional on a detector response Gram outside span(G2,G0)
operators.verdict: clean observable but not the requested local microscopic operator

exactNoGos.statement: On a closed defect, metric variation of pure BF and pure Chern-Simons terms gives zero bulk Hilbert stress because these actions use orientation but no metric.
For flat sectors f_a=f_c=0, every strictly local gauge-invariant polynomial built only from f_a, f_c, their covariant derivatives and a fixed local metric is identical in all Z3 holonomy sectors.
A charge q divisible by three is blind to residual Z3 holonomy, so the charge-three flavon cannot be the A11 holonomy reader.
Any response contribution whose fixed-probe Gram lies in span(G2,G0) merely changes the two scalar form factors and cannot produce the A11 third direction.

With CP or time reversal unbroken, conjugate flat sectors h=1 and h=2 are isospectral for ordinary charged matter; a signed h=1 versus h=2 splitting requires an orientation-sensitive observable or CP/T breaking.

minimalViableBridge.field: gapped defect-localized matter of residual charge q=1 or q=2
minimalViableBridge.reason: It is local, gauge consistent, metric dependent and can read a flat holonomy through its spectrum around a noncontractible cycle.
necessaryConditions: the charged field and its localization follow from the candidate action rather than being added only to fit A11
all gauge and localized anomalies cancel
the field is gapped so the BF sector remains approximately isolated
the compact cycle or equivalent multiply connected path is physically realized
the induced two-probe Gram G_phi has nonzero triple volume with G2 and G0
the resulting coefficient and frequency dependence are calculated before comparison with data

responseCriterion.holonomyCorrelation: the coefficient multiplying G_phi must vary with h under fixed probes and controls
responseCriterion.spin23Qualification: A third direction advances A11 beyond ambient-only geometry but does not establish full Sp(4,R) covariance.

syntheticCertificate.qualification: The coefficient and Gram matrix are synthetic witnesses of capacity, not values predicted by S_v1.
